description: This file defines the WordLoader class, a specialized document loader for Word documents using officeparser, extending BufferLoader, with methods to parse and split document content into sections.

classes.name: WordLoader
classes.description: A class that loads and parses Word documents into structured Document objects, extracting text content and metadata.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Asynchronously parses raw Buffer data of a Word document into an array of Document objects, extracting sections based on heuristics.

methods.name: splitIntoSections
methods.description: Splits document content into sections using common patterns like page, section, chapter headings, or separators.
